name: Alamo Food Equipment-Supplies
old_description: is your one-stop place to shop for new and used meat processing equipment and supplies.
about:
Alamo Food Equipment & Supplies, Inc. operates from Schertz, Texas, serving as a supplier of meat processing equipment and consumables. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business functions as a one-stop distributor for both new and used meat processing machinery, carrying brands such as Biro, Mainca, Promark, Minipack, Treif, and Risco. Its equipment lineup includes grinders, mixer grinders, band saws, vacuum sealers, stuffers, tumblers, tenderizers, slicers, dicers, bowl choppers, and metal detectors. In addition to hardware, the company stocks a broad range of consumables: vacuum pouches and films in multiple thicknesses, freezer paper, butcher paper, patty paper, steak paper, wax sheets, collagen and cellulose casings, seasoning blends, cures, spices, and butcher supplies such as saw blades, gloves, and tapes.

Customers span the meat and food processing sectors, including butcher shops, sausage makers, and commercial food processors that require both capital equipment and daily consumables. The company's catalog addresses needs from small-scale patty forming to industrial smokehouse operations.

Alamo positions itself as a single source for new and used equipment alongside a full slate of packaging and seasoning supplies, aiming to simplify procurement for food processing operations.
